instruction: Rename every regular file directly inside inbox/ so its name is normalized: lowercase, each run of characters other than a-z, 0-9 and '.' replaced by a single '-', and no leading or trailing '-' in the part before the extension (the extension is the text after the last '.', lowercased; files without a '.' have no extension). If two files would get the same name, process the original names in byte order; the first keeps the name and later ones get -2, -3, ... before the extension. File contents must not change. Then write inbox/INDEX with one line per file, `<new name> <old name>`, sorted by new name, ending with a newline.
